description: Source code for a Rust module implementing a filesystem abstraction that interacts with local filesystem and database-stored files, including initialization, file reading, modification checks, and path validation.

classes.name: FileSystem
classes.description: Struct managing local and database-backed file storage, with methods for initialization, file reading, modification checks, and path validation.

classes.name: DbFsQueries
classes.description: Struct holding prepared SQL statements for interacting with a database-stored file system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the FileSystem, setting local root and database queries, with fallback on error.

methods.name: modified_since
methods.description: Checks if a file has been modified since a given timestamp, considering local and database sources.

methods.name: read_to_string
methods.description: Reads a file as UTF-8 string, with error handling for invalid UTF-8 sequences.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads a file as bytes, from local filesystem or database if not found locally.

methods.name: safe_local_path
methods.description: Validates and constructs a safe local filesystem path, preventing directory traversal and reserved paths.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists locally or in the database.
